_comment: Starter LoRA library. Your own goes in data/library/loras.json (the web UI's LoRAs page writes it there); see docs/loras.md.

background_detail.note: Background Detail Enhancer (Krea2): more detail and clutter in the background. No trigger. Local only.
background_detail.tips: Author: 0.1-0.75. Prompt words that help: cluttered, detailed background, elaborate, intricate. Untuned on Krea2: start at 0.6.

realistic_snapshot.note: Realistic Snapshot v2 (MOSS-IMAGE + KREA2 + ZIT): casual smartphone-photo realism, boosts detail and skin texture. No trigger word. Local only.
realistic_snapshot.tips: The author recommends pushing it high: 1.5, sometimes up to 2.0 depending on the image. Style LoRA: it fights other grading LoRAs, so lower one of them when stacking. Also a candidate for the latent-upscale pass (hires_lora_scale scales it with the rest).

niji_sweet_spot.note: Niji Sweet Spot Krea2 v2_A (MJ Niji v7 look): semi-realistic digital render, dramatic cinematic lighting, luminous eyes, shallow depth of field. Trigger @NJSW33T. Local only.
niji_sweet_spot.tips: Author: 0.8-1.5, mostly 1.0 (v2 style is weaker than v1). Best for close-ups/portraits. Don't put a style in the prompt (realism, 3d, anime screenshot...) - it fights the LoRA. Pulls away from photoreal, so it clashes with realistic_snapshot. Euler + simple/beta.

mrpopo_anime.note: Mrpopo's Krea2 Anime/Art enhanced v3.0 (Full Potential): vivid anime art style, richer color and detail. No trigger. Local only.
mrpopo_anime.tips: Author recommends 10 steps and the HDR VAE (Anima/Qwen) for more vibrance; works without. Untuned: start at 1.0. An anime style in the prompt agrees with it; don't pair with realistic_snapshot.
